title: graphty data member, version 1
description: The graph itself inside a graphty document (container.md, 'The data member'), embedded as one of graph-io's JSON dialects. Normative for what a writer produces. Its members are closed: a reader skips a data member with a member this schema does not list.

dialect.description: The graph-io JSON dialect of the embedded graph: node-link, d3, jgf, cytoscape, graphology, vis, or one a later graph-io adds. A reader whose graph-io does not read it skips the member with E_UNKNOWN_FORMAT.

graph.description: The graph, embedded as a JSON value in the named dialect, written with that dialect's own member names.
